About the Interviewing Skills event

Interviewing Skills is a Leadership event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission. This event has special eligibility requirements, so check the guidelines with your advisor.

Ten step-by-step lessons for the HOSA Interviewing Skills solo event, designed for secondary members classified under IDEA, following the 2026–27 guidelines: eligibility and the IEP Verification and Accommodation Form, choosing a job you are trained for, telling your story with a story organizer, writing and formatting the personal statement, building a one-page resume, uploading one PDF (105 points) and the five-minute interview (80 points)—the two guaranteed questions, first impressions, the answer-example-connect plan, staying calm and ending strong. Written in clear, simple language with checklists, organizers and practice scenarios.
